description: An interception with no e-way bill at all and no expiry or clerical argument available. Detention costs run daily, so the correct advice is to pay under Section 129(1)(a) and secure release.
notice_text:
FORM GST MOV-07
[See rule 138]
Notice under Section 129(3) of the Act

Reference No : ZU090125336708        Date : 09/01/2025

GSTIN : 09AAGCB8814P1ZR
Name : M/s. BHARAT AGRO IMPLEMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED
Address : C 18 UPSIDC INDUSTRIAL AREA, KANPUR - 208022

Tax Period : FY 2024-25
Section under which notice is issued : 129
Date by which reply has to be submitted : 16/01/2025

The goods and the conveyance described in the order of detention have
been detained for the reason set out below. You are hereby called upon
to show cause why the tax and penalty proposed should not be payable.

1. E-way bill not tendered for the consignment intercepted in movement

   The vehicle was intercepted and the person in charge did not tender an e-way bill for the goods in movement. Tax and penalty are proposed under Section 129(1)(a) of the Act.

   Particulars                                   CGST           SGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Tax and penalty payable                27,000.00     27,000.00          0.00          0.00       54,000.00

The goods and conveyance shall be released on payment of the amount
proposed, or on furnishing security equivalent to that amount.

Proper Officer
Name : R K TIWARI
Designation : Assistant Commissioner, Mobile Squad
Jurisdiction : MOBILE SQUAD UNIT 2 , KANPUR , Uttar Pradesh

intake.issues: 1. E-way bill not tendered for the consignment intercepted in movement
intake.facts: Consignment of agricultural implements moved without any e-way bill being generated. The despatch clerk did not generate one and none was generated later. The invoice was genuine and the goods were accounted for, but there is no document to tender and no expiry or typographical argument available. The vehicle is detained and demurrage is running.
intake.documents_available: Tax invoice, delivery challan, transporter's consignment note, stock records

defects.heading: E-way bill not tendered for the consignment intercepted in movement

expected.outcome: Paid under Section 129(1)(a). Goods and conveyance released; no appeal filed.
expected.notes: There is no e-way bill and no argument that it was generated. Running a contest here costs more in detention than the penalty. A panel that manufactures a technical-breach argument on these facts has failed this matter, not won it.
